subject: *: Disable non-ga hash join types in hash join v2 (#59505)
summary: Commit disables hash join v2 for non-GA join types by default via `joinversion.UseHashJoinV2ForNonGAJoin=false`, while expanding `isGAForHashJoinV2` to treat `SemiJoin` and `AntiSemiJoin` as GA (still excluding NA-join, cross join, and NullEQ cases). Reviewed the planner/executor gating and minimal callers; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics risks identified for the affected join-type selection and fallback to hash join v1.
